raw_response:
I’m 70 this year, and it’s just me on this farm. Never went to school, but I’ve been farming these 10 mu for 55 years, so I know what I’m doing. My legs ache in the morning now, and I don’t have the strength I used to, so I have to plan things so I don’t kill myself. I don’t have much cash saved up — just what I made last year after buying my medicine — so I can’t afford fancy inputs. I do what I’ve always done: watch the neighbors, remember what happened on my own fields, and buy what I can afford.

I’ve got 7 mu that I do wheat and then maize on, same as always. The other 3.1 mu is cotton — that’s my cash money, but it’s hard on the back with all the picking and spraying.

**Wheat:** I’ll plant around the 10th of October. I use the same improved seed I got from the supply shop last year, costs about 30 yuan per mu. After the maize comes off, I hire Old Wang’s tractor to plow, then I harrow and level it myself. I broadcast the seed by hand — I don’t have one of those fancy planters. Before sowing I spread about one bag of compound fertilizer for every two mu as my base. Then in spring, when the wheat starts looking a bit yellow at jointing, I’ll spread some urea, maybe 20–25 jin per mu. I’ll water twice: once before winter freeze so the seedlings don’t dry out, and once in March or April if the sky won’t rain. Weeds are a bother, so I spray a bit of herbicide once. I expect about 760 jin per mu if the weather behaves, same as last year.

**Maize:** This goes in the same day the wheat comes off in early June — there’s no time to waste, the season is tight. I buy hybrid seed from the shop, about 40 yuan per mu. Old Wang rotovates quick and I plant the same day. I put one dose of compound fertilizer in the furrow at planting, and that’s usually enough. If July is dry and the leaves start curling, I’ll pump water once, maybe twice, but electricity for the pump is expensive now with the meters, so I pray for rain. I spray herbicide once when the weeds come up. Maize usually gives me about 800 jin per mu.

**Cotton:** I plant this on the other 3.1 mu in late April. I plow in spring and make ridges by hand. It needs bug spray — bollworms love it — so I keep insecticide and spray when I see holes in the leaves. I put down fertilizer before ridging and side-dress a bit more when it starts budding. I water twice, at flowering and when the bolls are setting. Picking is the worst part now that I’m old, so I hire a few women from the village for several days, pay them by the day. It hurts to spend that cash, but I can’t pick it all myself anymore. I hope for about 500 jin of seed cotton per mu.

Money is tight. I don’t buy the fancy slow-release stuff or whatever they advertise on the loudspeaker. I use what I can afford, and I do what worked before. Last year was okay, not great. I’d rather put down a bit more fertilizer than risk a bad crop, but I can’t go crazy because I need to keep some cash for my blood pressure medicine. Total I’m looking to spend around 4,700 yuan on all this. If the prices hold, I should be able to get through the year without borrowing.
